title: The Stable on West Street That Became Madam Walker's Factory
conflicts: Agent numbers: Bundles reports Walker's own 1917 claim of nearly 20,000 women trained, the Indiana Historical Society says several thousand agents; the story gives both with attribution (the NWHM's 40,000 is not used). YMCA gift: within a year of arrival (Bundles) vs 1912 (IHS exhibit page); the story gives no date.
notes: Sources limited to A'Lelia Bundles's biography-based writing (Encyclopedia of Indianapolis entry, madamcjwalker.com essay/FAQ) and the Indiana Historical Society (collection guide M0399, exhibit and Famous Hoosiers pages), as asked. The 1912 National Negro Business League episode appears only as the coda. Repeat screen flags Maggie Lena Walker (surname) and Matsushita (shared word 'Manufacturing') as same-founder but lets the edition through; no field was reworded.
